items.title: Formal and Game-theoretic Testing for SQL Query Migration Validation
items.summary: Kanishk Kaul, Ferhat Erata and Satyajit Gokhale also contributed to the article Validating that GenAI-translated SQL queries remain functionally equivalent when you migrate databases from Microsoft SQL Server (SQL Server) to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition is challenging. During migration, transformation tools automate the cross-dialect translation of SQL queries from SQL Server’s T-SQL to PostgreSQL’s PL/pgSQL. […]
